question: 14. Does ____________ look you in the eye when you are talking to him/her, playing with him/her, or changing him/her?

ask_yes_followup.text: Please give me an example of when he/she looks you in the eye. (If parent does not give one of the following 0 examples, ask each individually.)

evaluate_behaviors.instruction: Does he/she look you in the eye...
items: When you are playing with him/her?
When you are reading him/her a story?
When you are talking to him/her?

check_frequency_every_day.text: Does your child look you in the eye every day?

check_frequency_5_times.text: On a day when you are together all day, does he/she look you in the eye at least 5 times?
